name: Catan
description: Players collect and trade resources to build settlements, cities and roads.

name: Dixit
description: Players use imaginative clues to describe beautifully illustrated cards.

name: Carcassonne
description: Players build a medieval landscape using tiles and place followers to score points.

name: Codenames
description: Teams use one-word clues to identify their secret agents among word cards.

name: Uno
description: Players take turns matching a card from their hand to the top card of the discard pile by color, number, or symbol, aiming to be the first to get rid of all their cards while shouting "UNO!" when down to their last one.

name: Pandemic
description: Players cooperate to stop the spread of diseases and save the world.

name: Azul
description: Players draft colorful tiles to create patterns and score points.

name: Monopoly
description: Players buy, trade, and develop properties to collect rent and bankrupt their opponents.

name: Chess
description: A classic two-player tactical strategy game played on an 8x8 checkered board with the goal of checkmating the opponent's king.
